title: Hon Chan Voi and the islands in Ha Long
excerpt: Through the tectonic process with the formation of nature, Ha Long has many large and small islands, among which the most beautiful is Hon Chan Voi and the islands in Ha Long with a unique beauty, surrounded by majestic high rocky mountains
html:
Through the tectonic process with the formation of nature, Ha Long has many large and small islands, among which the most beautiful is Hon Chan Voi and the islands in Ha Long with a unique beauty, surrounded by majestic high rocky mountains, and poetic beaches, besides there are also mysterious caves creating a poetic picture.

Currently, Hon Chan Voi is one of the attractive destinations in Ha Long, located about 12km from Tuan Chau port, and about 10km from Bai Chay, this is an ideal destination every summer.

Hon Chan Voi is formed by a block of lifeless rock, but with a unique and cute shape, the island has increasingly attracted tourists to visit and admire, especially when viewed from afar on a cruise ship, visitors will admire an unusual beauty.

Many tourists when traveling to Ha Long visit Hon Chan Voi to admire the beauty of this very close and familiar animal, a check-in spot chosen by many young people.

With the name Chan Voi because the rocks standing up look like the footsteps of an elephant standing tall in the middle of the ocean, the beauty standing tall in the wind makes visitors to the bay feel more excited by this natural beauty.

After many years and changes of nature, Hon Chan Voi is still there with a unique and intact shape, there are many species growing on the cliffs, making this island more beautiful than ever.

The most beautiful time to travel Ha Long is in the summer and autumn, a general beauty and Hon Chan Voi in particular, when the sunlight begins to shine, it will exude a unique beauty that the island paradise brings to visitors.

In spring, Hon Chan Voi is covered with a lush green coat of conical trees clinging to the cliffs, budding in the cool weather, adding to the natural beauty, a picture that nature has bestowed upon Ha Long.

It can be said that Hon Chan Voi is a masterpiece bestowed upon Ha Long by nature, becoming an attractive destination for tourists. Besides Ha Long, it is also a destination with many famous islands. Let’s take a look at those islands in the article below.

Hon Trong Mai

Also known as Hon Ga Choi, from afar it looks like two chickens facing each other, a natural rock with a unique shape emerging on the water surface, looking like poetic paintings attracting tourists to visit and enjoy the scenery from nature.

Dinh Huong Islet

Looks like a large incense burner floating in the middle of the sea, according to the locals, Dinh Huong Islet is very important in the spiritual life of fishermen in the coastal area, when the tide goes down, it reveals a natural beauty, a sturdy and majestic incense burner, located majestically in the middle of the sea.

Con Rua Islet

A masterpiece that nature has bestowed upon this place, from afar it looks like a giant turtle floating on the sea surface, covered with a layer of green animals, many tourists often sit on a cruise to admire the poetic scenery.

Hon Yen Ngua

Located right in the center of Ha Long Bay, endowed by nature with a unique shape created by the rows of rocks, to fully admire the beauty of Yen Ngua Islet, many tourists when going on a tour Ha Long often choose a cruise to admire the scenery and record the most beautiful moments.

Finger Island

Hearing this, many tourists think it is in Phu Quoc, but Ha Long also has the beauty of Finger Island because the name is similar to Phu Quoc. Coming here in the summer, tourists will feel the natural beauty that nature has bestowed on Ha Long.

Toad Island

A naturally formed rock, from afar it looks like a toad sitting and praying for rain, located majestically in the middle of Ha Long Bay, creating a beautiful natural picture.

In addition, to increase the excitement of your tour, you can choose to experience night squid fishing, overnight stay on a cruise, all of which make your Ha Long trip more meaningful in the island paradise.
